mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 61 degrees at Verona City Hall under clear skies, with an air quality index of 82. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight's low will be 52 degrees, and there is no rain expected.

The City of Verona has several items on the agenda for the November 4th Plan Commission meeting, including the Ardent Glen third addition final plat and site plans for 1979 Milky Way. Additionally, property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th, and residents can pay in two installments with options to pay online or at the City Center drop boxes.

There is a busy schedule ahead for our community. Enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee today. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market at the Capitol or catch music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, mark your calendars for yoga on October 26th and various trivia nights starting October 27th.

Regarding local safety, the Verona Police Department reported an incident from Thursday, October 15th, where a school bus driver was arrested for O W I while transporting students. Fortunately, no injuries were reported.

Today is the perfect day to stop by for the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day. The store is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to head over and enjoy a scoop.
